name: 3agapp/woo-product-sync-manager
description: Shows Product Sync Manager's marketplace orders (Nalda, Temu) in WooCommerce: an orders column, an order panel, delivery status for the marketplace, a delivery note, and no customer emails.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Check the plugin against the WooCommerce/WordPress coding standards.
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Automatically fix the coding standard violations that can be fixed.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the PHPUnit suite against the WordPress test library.
scripts-descriptions.check: Run everything CI runs before it builds: validate, version, i18n, lint, test.
scripts-descriptions.i18n: Re-extract the POT and recompile every translation catalogue.
scripts-descriptions.i18n:check: Check the POT still lists every translatable string in the source.
scripts-descriptions.build: Build the distributable plugin zip into dist/.
